task.description:
Execute SCH-01 test run and produce a structured report.

Required execution:
- Run SCH-01 relevant unit/integration tests and any required companion suites to verify no regressions.
- Validate AC coverage from tests/specs/SCH-01.md.
- Record any failures with severity classification and root-cause hints.

Output:
- Write test report artifact under tests/reports/ for this run.
- If failures are unrelated pre-existing issues, identify them explicitly and classify impact on SCH-01 verdict.
acceptance_criteria: Result status reflects blocking vs non-blocking failures
Issues list includes severity and affected requirement when known

result.summary: Executed SCH-01 test run with required companion suites. Unit and integration layers passed (unit: 266 pass, 102 skip, 0 fail; integration: 151 pass, 6 skip, 0 fail). SCH-01 acceptance criteria AC-1 through AC-5 are covered by TC-SCH-01-01..05 and passed.
